findings.highlight: pours herself a cup of warm water.
findings.evidenceJa: 湯飲みに手を伸ばした
findings.governingReading: 湯飲みに手を伸ばした identifies reaching toward the cup after sitting.
findings.explanation: Reaching for a teacup becomes pouring warm water.

findings.governingReading: 背骨に差し込まれた炎の鞭 gives a whip-of-fire bodily circuit image being withdrawn.
findings.explanation: A fiery whip becomes a red-hot rod.

findings.highlight: All I can do is Strengthen something into a weapon.
findings.evidenceJa: 武器を用意しておく事しかできない
findings.governingReading: 武器を用意しておく specifies advance preparation because forming circuits takes a minute and surprise counterattack is impossible.
findings.explanation: Only preparing Strengthened weapons ahead of time becomes only Strengthening something into a weapon.

findings.highlight: If you want someone to talk to before you go back to bed
findings.evidenceJa: 寝てばっかりで目が冴えてるんなら
findings.governingReading: Shirou offers conversation if all her resting has left Sakura wide awake.
findings.explanation: The offer loses its specific reason: Sakura may be wide awake after resting so much. Shirou still offers her companionship.

findings.highlight: This is like asking me to fix the VCR that Fuji-nee cut in half!
findings.evidenceJa: あんなの直すぐらいなら藤ねえが真っ二つにしたビデオデッキを直すぞ
findings.governingReading: Shirou had complained that he would sooner repair Taiga's bisected VCR than tackle the heater.
findings.explanation: The English keeps the broken-VCR joke but changes “I'd sooner fix that” into “this is like fixing that,” softening the heater's exaggerated difficulty.

findings.highlight: I hope you realize that you were out of line earlier.
findings.evidenceJa: さっきのは、ほんとに悪いコトをしたんだなあって反省したんですよ
findings.governingReading: 迷惑をかけてばかりですけど……反省したんですよ continues her first-person acknowledgment of troubling him and reflecting she truly did something bad earlier.
findings.explanation: Sakura’s remorse for her own action becomes asking Shirou to realize he was out of line.

findings.highlight: someone strong who helps the weak.
findings.evidenceJa: 弱きを助け強きをくじく
findings.governingReading: 弱きを助け強きをくじく pairs protection with resistance to the strong.
findings.explanation: Helping the weak and defeating the strong becomes being strong and helping the weak.

findings.evidenceJa: 我が身を振り返っちまう
findings.governingReading: 我が身を振り返っちまう and 恥ずかしい say praise makes him look back at himself and feel embarrassed.
findings.explanation: Reflecting on himself in embarrassment becomes regretting everything he ever did.

findings.governingReading: 道場で正座したり imagines the physical formal sitting alongside riverbank running.
findings.explanation: Sitting formally in the dojo becomes meditating.

findings.highlight: found meaning in helping as many people as I could
findings.evidenceJa: 一人だけ助かった意味を探して
findings.governingReading: He ran around town searching for meaning in having been the only one saved.
findings.explanation: An unresolved search for the meaning of his solitary survival becomes an achieved sense of purpose through helping others. This changes why Shirou says he kept himself constantly occupied.

findings.evidenceJa: 他のヤツより何倍も怒る
findings.governingReading: 何倍も intensifies anger beyond ordinary people without assigning a fixed multiplier.
findings.explanation: Many times angrier becomes exactly twice as angry.

findings.governingReading: 一年半 corrects two years to the remembered precise elapsed period.
findings.explanation: A year and a half loses the second article.
